arStrings.szText: "Is this where your second Passage is, Tharra?"
Yes, if the Oracle allows. The rift between our orders runs deep. I wish to repair it.
Our hopes align. Yet it is one thing to declare friendship, and another to earn it. To earn your Passage, you must walk our path as each prospect must. Bear our rituals. Know our sight.
Young seers take a pilgrimage across our lands to three shrines. One of clay, one of life, and one of sight. Walk them, then return to me.
Emphasis on the three trials' names.
